column1: # The building-and-organization pattern: CORE.md's rule "one reading where a word has two" is broken by nodes filed both as a
# building (physical-object) and as an organization (agent, group). WordNet's synset is the building in each case; the
# organization edge came from schema.org/YAGO/Wikidata, whose classes join the two. Which reading the name keeps is a sense decision.

column3: a pharmacy can be both a place and an organization? Then these too?
column5: building + organization: a group of people that is also a building; WordNet 03540595 is the building
building + organization (WordNet 03542333 is the building)
building + organization (WordNet 03661043 is the building)
building + organization (WordNet 04081281 is the building); cafe inherits
workplace + shop + organization (WordNet 02776631 is the workplace)
works + place + organization (WordNet 02897237 is the plant)
works + organization (WordNet 03316406 is the plant)
structure + place + organization (WordNet 03461385 is the marketplace); supermarket inherits
facility + organization (WordNet 02735086 is the depository)
farm + organization (WordNet 03159535 is the farm)
region + organization (WordNet 02945594 is the site)
WordNet 02669885 is "a learned establishment for the advancement of knowledge" (an academy of sciences is not a school); also structure + organization
organization + place: the polity (WordNet 08168978, the node's sense) and the territory are two readings; in(japan) needs the place, agent needs the polity

WordNet files railway (noun.artifact, lemmas railway_line, railway_system) under the company sense of line; the name reads as the track system, and metro ("an electric railway operating below the surface") inherits organization and agent
whether viruses are organisms is contested (no cells, no metabolism of their own); four sources assert it, biology textbooks divide
CORE.md lists owner among the roles that are not categories ("relations to a filler"); WordNet's sense is the owner of a business, the name reads as any owner

removing amount ⊑ quantity (the concept) leaves amount at the top level, as WordNet has measure (with relation and part core now has fourteen top-level branches); the alternative is attribute (ontodag's dimensions are attributes), but teardrops and helpings of food are under amount too
money ⊑ currency ⊑ artifact makes all money a metal or paper medium; bank money is not, and CORE.md files money under possession
WordNet's synset is the title ("he held the title for two years", ⊑ status); Cyc and YAGO add the competition (⊑ event); one node cannot be both a status and an event
WordNet's enticement sense (⊑ motivation, placed under cognition); fishing bait is a physical thing; core has no true parent for both
"a small part of something intended as representative of the whole": a blood or soil sample is a physical part, not an item of information
removing relation ⊑ concept leaves relation at the top level (WordNet's own placement); the alternative is attribute (ontodag's reading of qualities: things standing in a relation)

removing part ⊑ relation leaves part at the top level with detail, highlight, residual, beginning and middle; part is a role category (ROLES.md: parts go under in(...)), so dropping it is the other choice

group + activity: "a formally arranged gathering" is the people (WordNet's sense, "the meeting elected a chairperson") and the event (conference, summit, forum, engagement since v13); one reading where a word has two

the services layer files acts under service ("work done by one person or group that benefits another") that are often done for oneself: housework, cleaning, repair, ironing, recycling, photography, shaving (via beauty-treatment); true of the CPC product, not of every act

WordNet's phenomena (consequence, luck, good-fortune, market-demand) sit under process ("a sustained phenomenon ... through a series of states") because WordNet files phenomenon under process; luck and demand are not processes. UPPER.md §15.2 left phenomenon open

book ⊑ document (Peter) and ⊑ publication ⊑ product ⊑ artifact: the work and the printed copy in one node; CORE.md says a document is information only, the goods layer sells copies (periodical and magazine likewise)
Peter's ruling; machine is "any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy", and a canoe, a sled, a stroller, a glider or a hang-glider is not one
Peter's ruling; reservoirs ("artificial lake"), canals and harbours are bodies of water and are man-made, so reservoir ⊑ lake ⊑ body-of-water makes it a natural object

CORE.md: "Roles and stages are out. pet, child, adult are not kinds" and "author, owner, sender, pet are relations to a filler"; pet, child, adult and owner are in core all the same (the edges are true, the nodes are against the policy)

WordNet's sense is the outline of a face seen from one side (⊑ view); Cyc's and SUMO's information edge is the other sense, a description of a person; for OntoDAG's users the name reads as a user profile
three readings in one node: the field, the shop and the business (the building/organization pattern above)

column3: concept is quite bad, everything in ontodag is a concept; information
column5: an architecture is an idea, but a trained model (GPT, BERT) is software; under concept ⊑ idea ⊑ cognition every language model is a thought

column3: No, there are machine learning things that are not AI
column5: about 250 ai entries are filed as fields of study; most are subfields, but some are tasks or techniques (cross-validation, image segmentation, grid search). The clear algorithms and measures were moved; the rest needs a field/technique decision
the hardware and the software in one node: web servers, proxy servers and file servers are machines and programs at once
WordNet's chain makes an interest rate a price charged and so a possession (an outgo); it is a ratio
core's problem is a topic (a question raised for consideration), under information; catastrophic forgetting, vanishing gradients and reward hacking are phenomena or difficulties
core's telescope is WordNet's "magnifier of images of distant objects"; a radio telescope magnifies no image
core's dictionary is under book, "printed on pages bound together"; Wiktionary, GeoNames and the Getty thesaurus are web resources (book is already a row above)
